timing: Method frozen while timed capture suite is running, before any received-audio ASR; expected facts were already declared in the suite protocol.
scope: All eight declared whole received PCM streams, in original order, retaining failures/unavailable rows in the denominator.
method: Pinned production LocalSTT through offline cached Parakeet on local-mac; resample entire mono PCM16 24 kHz to16 kHz with existing helper. No trimming, silence removal, retries or capture-success selection.

review.baseline_and_probes: Airport navigation started and 88-minute ETA complete; retain proper-name/number deviations.
review.correction: Old airport result is interrupted, new office result completes and states replacement of the airport. Retain all contradictory or missing text.
review.score: Verbatim ASR plus qualitative fact review only, not held-out accuracy or independent intelligibility.

limitations: Production ASR proxy cannot distinguish pronunciation from recognition errors; no human listening.
Whole-stream text does not establish word timestamps or physical playback.
Eight repeated synthetic development captures share warm models and a fixed order.
Review is performed only after timed suite and owned model services have stopped. Its timings are separate from conversation latency.
